content.intro: Convert pound per sq. inchs (psi) to atmospheres (atm) instantly. Both measure pressure, so the relationship is strictly linear: each pound per sq. inch equals 0.068045964 atmospheres. Use the converter above for any value, or read on for the formula, a quick lookup table, and practical tips.
content.result_section: One pound per sq. inch is equal to **0.068045964 atmospheres**. To go the other way, one atmosphere equals **14.695949 pound per sq. inchs**. For everyday use, rounding to 2–4 decimal places is usually enough; for engineering or scientific work, keep the full precision shown by the converter.
content.formula_section:
The conversion is a single multiplication:

> atmospheres = pound per sq. inchs × 0.068045964

Worked example — converting 10 pound per sq. inchs:

10 × 0.068045964 = **0.68045964 atm**.

To invert, divide by 0.068045964 (or multiply by 14.695949).

content.tips:
Keep the factor handy: 1 psi ≈ 0.068045964 atm. For rough mental math, round to the nearest sensible digit.

Mind the units. Pound per Sq. Inch and Atmosphere both measure pressure; squared or cubic variants need a different factor (factor², factor³).

When precision matters (engineering, lab work, dosing), avoid rounding mid-calculation — convert once at the final step using the full factor.
